[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Bead previews for K in the prompt input[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing K in the prompt input's NORMAL mode on a bead ID [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](bob-cli-kx, sase-1ss.1) or an @bead:<id> ref opens a fast, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]theme-aware bead card that never blocks typing. The card shows the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bead's identity, status, description, phases, lineage, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dependencies, and plan, and lets you drill into related beads or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]open the full detail. Ctrl+] opens the full bead detail too. Bead [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]IDs that resolve get a status-tinted underline, so the K affordance[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is visible before you press it. Hyphenated words that are not beads[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]keep today's word lookup.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#AF87FF]peek[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]meter, and dependencies to the card, in-card drill-down (1-9, p, [/#D7D7AF]
